Travel paperwork evening rules

This section keeps evening desk work steady, clear, and fast for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. The purpose is to make sure passenger and pet arrangements are checked, recorded, and passed on without delay.

When a traveler reaches the desk, staff must stay calm, speak plainly, and confirm the needed travel papers before moving on. Any change to a companion animal booking must be read back to the traveler, then entered in the desk ledger right away. If a record looks incomplete, staff should pause the handoff and ask for the missing detail through the welcome team, rather than guessing or waiting for the next shift to sort it out. Keep all notes brief, accurate, and respectful, because passengers rely on clean communication when moving between skyports.

If Miso, Lucas Hernandez, or Sara Torres appear in the file, treat the entry the same way as any other case and avoid side talk. No staff member should promise boarding support that is not already approved. If the desk is busy, finish the current record before opening a new one, and keep the ledger in order.

For urgent follow-up, contact the senior coordinator or the duty lead right away.
